[[{{PAGENAME}}]] is a [[Missions|Mission]] on [[Olympus]] in the [[Forest|Forest Biome]]. This mission cannot be started as an [[Operation]] in an [[Open World]].

{{PAGENAME}} is '''not''' required to unlock subsequent missions on [[Olympus]].

There is no difference in difficulty between Easy and Normal, except for experience gain and reward amount.
{{Mission Briefing
|title = UDA-MANDATED FIRST DROP FOR NEW PROSPECTORS
|operator=UDA
|biome=Forest
|background=UDA regulations require new Icarus arrivals to demonstrate basic survival skills in this region before accepting further contracts.
|mission=Prospectors are not expected to pursue specific objectives. Survival is deemed fulfilment.
|terms=Contractors will be provided with a functioning envirosuit, and basic crafting information. They will be otherwise unassisted. No further tasking will occur until basic competency is attained.
}}

==Objectives==
'''Recon: Forest Zone'''
* Hunt, gather, craft.
** Low on water: Find a {{Icon link|Water|water source}} to drink from.
** Low on oxygen: Find {{Item icon|Oxite|blue oxites rocks}} on the ground to consume.
** Low on food: Find {{Item icon|Wild Berry|berries}}, {{Item icon|Cooked Meat|meat}} or other [[Food|food]] to eat.
* Gather {{Item icon|Stick|Sticks}}, {{Item icon|Stone|Stones}} off the ground and {{Item icon|Fiber}} from bushes then open the Crafting Menu (O) and Craft a {{Item icon|Stone Axe}} for Protection
*All your actions grant experience: Level up for access to new skills and blueprints.
**You leveled up: Spend your [[Blueprints|Blueprint]] and [[Talents|Talent Points]] (P)
*Unlock a {{Item icon|Wood Rag Torch}} (P) and Craft it with (O) to provide yourself light during the night
*Build a shelter and craft a {{Item icon|Bedroll|bedroll}} to survive the harsh Icarus environment.
*Interact and Launch your Dropship to Complete the Mission
----
* Press (J) to open the Field Guide for more world and items information.

== Hints and Tips==
While {{PAGENAME}} is the first mission Prospectors may participate in, it is marked as completed by default. It does not count towards the overall mission progress for the achievement [[Achievements#Zero_To_Hero|Zero To Hero]].

It is recommended that new prospectors begin with this mission before proceeding to [[Open World]]. Since there is no difference between Easy and Normal difficulty, it is recommended to play on Normal difficulty or above to avoid the experience and reward penalty.

The {{Item icon|Wood Torch}} does not count towards the objective "to provide yourself light during the night", prospectors will need to craft the Wood Rag Torch.

The {{Item icon|Bedroll}} will need to be in [[Shelter|shelter]] in order for the objective to count. The bedroll can be picked up and placed back down after the objective has been completed, and the prospector will not lose progress.

Prospectors by default will have the following blueprints unlocked: {{Item icon|Stone Axe}}, {{Item icon|Stone Pickaxe}}, {{Item icon|Wood Pile}}, {{Item icon|Stone Pile}}
* Using Wood Piles and Stone Piles is an optimal way to store {{Item icon|Wood}} and {{Item icon|Stone}} until the prospector unlocks alternate storage methods.

Unlocking the {{Item icon|Stone Knife}} is required to skin [[Fauna|animals]] in order to gather the {{Item icon|Fur}} and {{Item icon|Leather}} needed to craft the Bedroll.
* Unlocking a ranged weapon like the {{Item icon|Wood Bow}} and {{Item icon|Stone Arrow|Stone Arrows}} can help prospectors hunt animals easier.
* Some weapons have throwing variants that unlock with a single blueprint point. Unlocking the Stone Knife also unlocks the {{Item icon|Stone Throwing Knife}}, just like how the {{Item icon|Wood Spear}} will also unlock {{Item icon|Wood Javelin|Wood Javelins}}. These can be used as alternatives to Bows and Arrows for ranged hunting.
* Sneaking by crouching ({{Key|keyboard|Ctrl}}) provides a 2.5x times damage modifier if the target is unaware of your presence, indicated by the "eye" icon in the lower-center of your screen.

[[Weather Events]] on {{PAGENAME}} is not as severe as on other prospects. When playing on normal difficulty, the highest-tier storm a prospector will encounter is a Tier 1 storm. At full exposure, this can harm the prospector, but it can be easily countered by consuming {{Item icon|Cooked Meat}} to replenish the lost health.
* It is possible for prospectors to "Jump" back into their drop pods and wait out the storms, but the positioning to be "In Shelter" (to reduce exposure) can be tricky.
